headline: Indian Markets Resume Trading as Foreign Investors Return and Benchmarks Rally to Multi-Month Highs

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign investors are returning to Indian equities, signaling confidence in longer-term bets.
Sensex and Nifty have rallied over 6% in recent sessions to reach their highest levels in over eight months.
Individual ownership in NSE-listed firms reached a record high of 19.5% in Q2FY27.
India VIX has gained 18% over the last three weeks, highlighting increased market volatility.
whatHappening: Blackstone is acquiring approximately a 16% stake in IIFL Finance for $535 million.
NMDC is reportedly in talks with Russia's Rosatom regarding lithium investment opportunities.
Urban youth unemployment hit a six-quarter high in Q2, with Kerala leading among states.
US Federal Reserve officials signaled potential rapid rate hikes following strong inflation data.
summary: Indian markets return to trading following recent holiday breaks amid strong institutional momentum and multi-month highs on benchmark indices. Retail participation in NSE-listed equities hit a record high of 19.5% in Q2 FY27. Major corporate moves include Blackstone buying a stake in IIFL Finance and NMDC exploring lithium partnerships.
